Catalytic ATP-binding subunit LolD (b1117) of the Escherichia coli K-12 LolCDE lipoprotein-releasing ABC transporter complex inhibited by lolamicin (DOI:10.1038/s41586-024-07502-0; PMID:38811738).

Inner-membrane transmembrane subunit LolE (b1118) of the Escherichia coli K-12 LolCDE lipoprotein-releasing ABC transporter complex, which forms the lipoprotein-binding cavity targeted by lolamicin and harbors resistance substitutions (DOI:10.1038/s41586-024-07502-0; PMID:38811738).

added_history_event.changes: Added reviewed UniProtKB:P0ADC3 (LolC), UniProtKB:P75957 (LolD), and UniProtKB:P75958 (LolE) Escherichia coli K-12 protein examples to the PRIMARY_LITERATURE molecular target (DOI:10.1038/s41586-024-07502-0).

after_protein_examples.role: Transmembrane subunit LolC (b1116) of the Escherichia coli LolCDE lipoprotein transport complex to which laboratory-evolved enterololin resistance mutations predominantly mapped (DOI:10.1038/s41564-025-02142-0; PMID:41044363).

Transmembrane subunit LolE (b1118) of the Escherichia coli LolCDE lipoprotein transport complex to which laboratory-evolved enterololin resistance mutations predominantly mapped (DOI:10.1038/s41564-025-02142-0; PMID:41044363).

after_protein_examples.role: Candida albicans SC5314 GPI-anchor inositol acyltransferase Gwt1 (C7_00150W_A) directly inhibited by manogepix (E1210, APX001A), blocking inositol acylation of glucosaminyl-phosphatidylinositol and cell-wall mannoprotein localization (PMID:21670182; DOI:10.1128/aac.01723-25).

added_history_event.changes: Added reviewed UniProtKB:Q873N2 (Candida albicans SC5314 GWT1) protein example to the PRIMARY_LITERATURE molecular target (DOI:10.1128/aac.01723-25).

after_protein_examples.role: Class D carbapenem-hydrolyzing beta-lactamase OXA-48 (blaOXA-48) from Klebsiella pneumoniae covalently carbamylated at active-site Ser70 by avibactam in the PMID:25406838 X-ray crystal structures (PDB:4S2K, 4S2N, 4WMC) and carbamylation/decarbamylation kinetic assays; Acinetobacter baumannii OXA-24/OXA-40 (PDB:4WM9, Q8RLA6_ACIBA) cocrystallized in the same study is an unreviewed TrEMBL entry and is not added as a reviewed example.

added_history_event.changes: Added reviewed UniProtKB:Q6XEC0 (Klebsiella pneumoniae OXA-48, blaOXA-48) protein example to the class D OXA beta-lactamases PRIMARY_LITERATURE molecular target (PMID:25406838).

after_protein_examples.role: Staphylococcus aureus strain MRSA252 pyruvate kinase (pyk, SAR1776) cloned, purified, and inhibited by bromodeoxytopsentin with nanomolar potency (IC50 = 60 nM, Ki = 34 nM) in the PMID:22030393 enzymatic assays; the cocrystal structure in the same study (PDB:3T07) bound the synthetic bis-indole analog IS130 to the dimer interface of this MRSA252 enzyme.

added_history_event.changes: Added reviewed UniProtKB:Q6G8M9 (Staphylococcus aureus MRSA252 pyk, SAR1776) protein example to the pyruvate kinase PRIMARY_LITERATURE molecular target (PMID:22030393).

after_protein_examples.role: FAD-dependent decaprenylphosphoryl-beta-D-ribose 2'-oxidase DprE1 (Rv3790) of Mycobacterium tuberculosis H37Rv that reduces the nitro group of BTZ043 to a nitroso intermediate and forms a covalent semimercaptal adduct at Cys387, where Cys387Ser/Gly substitutions confer high-level resistance (DOI:10.1126/science.1171583; PMID:19299584).

added_history_event.changes: Added reviewed UniProtKB:P9WJF1 (Mycobacterium tuberculosis H37Rv dprE1, Rv3790) protein example to the PRIMARY_LITERATURE molecular target (DOI:10.1126/science.1171583).

after_protein_examples.role: Decaprenylphosphoryl-beta-D-ribose 2'-oxidase DprE1 (Rv3790) of Mycobacterium tuberculosis H37Rv noncovalently inhibited by the 1,4-azaindole TBA-7371 (IC50 = 10 nM), with resistance mapping to Tyr314His in rv3790 (DOI:10.1021/jm401382v; PMID:24215368).

added_history_event.changes: Added reviewed UniProtKB:P9WJF1 (Mycobacterium tuberculosis H37Rv dprE1, Rv3790) protein example to the PRIMARY_LITERATURE molecular target (DOI:10.1021/jm401382v).

after_protein_examples.role: Inner-membrane RND trehalose monomycolate transporter MmpL3 (Rv0206c) of Mycobacterium tuberculosis H37Rv targeted by SQ109, blocking trehalose monomycolate export to the mycomembrane and harboring resistance mutations (Q40R, L567P, A700T) selected by SQ109 analogs (DOI:10.1128/AAC.05708-11; PMID:22252828).

added_history_event.changes: Added reviewed UniProtKB:P9WJV5 (Mycobacterium tuberculosis H37Rv mmpL3, Rv0206c) protein example to the PRIMARY_LITERATURE molecular target (DOI:10.1128/AAC.05708-11).

after_protein_examples.role: Staphylococcus aureus cell division GTPase FtsZ whose GTPase activity is inhibited by PC190723 (IC50 = 55 ng/mL) and whose interdomain cleft binds PC190723 in the cocrystal structure (PDB:4DXD) and harbors resistance mutations (G193D, G196C/S/A, N263K; DOI:10.1126/science.1159961; PMID:18801997; PMID:22440737).

Bacillus subtilis strain 168 cell division protein FtsZ (BSU15290) shown by GFP-FtsZ fluorescence microscopy in DOI:10.1126/science.1159961 (PMID:18801997) to mislocalize into discrete foci and fail to constrict the cytokinetic Z-ring upon PC190723 exposure.

added_history_event.changes: Added reviewed UniProtKB:P0A031 (Staphylococcus aureus ftsZ) and UniProtKB:P17865 (Bacillus subtilis 168 ftsZ) protein examples to the PRIMARY_LITERATURE molecular target (DOI:10.1126/science.1159961).

after_protein_examples.role: Staphylococcus aureus cell division protein FtsZ targeted by TXA707, where TXA707 stimulates FtsZ polymerization, disrupts septum formation, and selects resistance substitutions at Gly196 and Gly193 in the interdomain binding pocket (DOI:10.1128/AAC.00708-15; PMID:26033735).

Staphylococcus aureus strain NCTC 8325 cell division protein FtsZ (SAOUHSC_01150) cocrystallized in complex with TXA707 in the interdomain binding cleft (PDB:5XDT; PMID:28621933; DOI:10.1128/AAC.00708-15).

added_history_event.changes: Added reviewed UniProtKB:P0A031 (Staphylococcus aureus ftsZ) and UniProtKB:Q2FZ89 (Staphylococcus aureus NCTC 8325 ftsZ, SAOUHSC_01150) protein examples to the PRIMARY_LITERATURE molecular target (DOI:10.1128/AAC.00708-15).

after_protein_examples.role: Bacillus subtilis strain 168 50S ribosomal subunit protein uL2 (rplB, BSU01130) in which spontaneous and ectopically expressed Glu236Ala and Glu236Gln substitutions confer specific resistance to bactobolin A (MIC shift from 0.31 to 4.2-5.0 ug/mL; DOI:10.1128/mBio.00499-12; PMID:23249812).

Thermus thermophilus strain HB8 50S ribosomal subunit protein uL2 (rplB, TTHA1676) that directly coordinates bactobolin A via its conserved Glu236 loop at the P-site tRNA/23S rRNA interface in the 70S ribosome cocrystal structure (PDB:4WT8; DOI:10.1016/j.jmb.2014.12.018; PMID:25562208).

added_history_event.changes: Added reviewed UniProtKB:P42919 (Bacillus subtilis 168 rplB, BSU01130) and UniProtKB:P60405 (Thermus thermophilus HB8 rplB, TTHA1676) protein examples to the PRIMARY_LITERATURE molecular target (DOI:10.1128/mBio.00499-12).
